item_short_desc: Rothco’s Kid’s Reversible Web Belt combines durability, comfort, and versatility, making it perfect for everyday use. Made from 100% cotton, this belt is both soft and strong, featuring a fully adjustable buckle for a customizable fit. The reversible design offers two stylish color options in one belt, giving kids the freedom to switch up their look. Measuring 1” wide and 34” long, this belt is ideal for casual wear, school uniforms, or outdoor adventures.
